summary: The plan now carries rulings D5-D7 (AnsibleSpecs 204639e). P10 registers pipelines auto-synced the way charts is, so the site goes live in the test phase; V12 lost its owed_after and the run checks it; P7, P8, V14 and V16 follow. The placeholder manifest is pushed to PipelinesDeploy (d3b112a), and the dry run gates all 11 phases cleanly. No prd ruling covers the Architecture push, which redeploys the architecture viewer in prd; the plan cites that repo's push-as-you-go rule for it.
